Setting motor power makes the wheel spin.

Power ranges -1.0 (reverse) to 1.0 (forward). The motor's controller translates this into current.

Declare a private DcMotor field.

In init(), get "front_left_motor" from hardwareMap.
In loop(), set the motor power to 0.5. This drives at half speed forward.

Use getRuntime() to check elapsed time.

When it exceeds 2.0 seconds, set motor power to 0.0.

This stops without blocking. The OpMode stays responsive.
